name: Mercure Baku City
desc: Mercure Baku City is an ideal destination for travelers seeking a blend of modern comfort and authentic Azerbaijani experiences. The hotel offers a stylish and elegant atmosphere, combining contemporary design with the rich traditions of Baku, the cultural, historical and business hub of Azerbaijan. Guests can explore the city unique architecture, museums and breathtaking views of the Caspian Sea.
